description: Use this when an agent needs US government alerts (USGS earthquakes, CISA KEV, openFDA recalls, Federal Register). Pass stream (default usgs_quakes). kind="intuitive" (default): latest item; kind="stats": recent items; kind="pro": 4-stream digest; kind="signals": severity flags. Returns JSON `data` with attribution. Kinds: intuitive (5 sats or $0.003 USDC), stats (17 sats or $0.01 USDC), pro (33 sats or $0.02 USDC), signals (33 sats or $0.02 USDC), standalone (5 sats or $0.003 USDC). Pay: L402 (`l402_credential`), x402 (`x402_payment`), or `credit_token` (https://api.bittuitive.ai/pay, bittuitive://guide/pricing). Info only; not financial/legal advice; no warranty.

x402_payment.description: Base64 x402 Base USDC payment (or params._meta['x402/payment']).
